race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 3YOF 1st Semi Final Pace
race.comment: PRE EMINANT (4) has ground to make up on race rival BETTOR BEACH through last week's second but she was was first up for nine months there so will be better for the outing and also draws on the front row this time. Was ultra consistent against the top fillies last season. Chance to turn the tables. BETTOR BEACH (12) though is impossible to knock after her impressive win by 13m in the heats. Returns to a circuit where she has won two of three attempts and if things go her way from the back row she can certainly strike again. ALOT LIKE JEANNIE (5) led and fought well to get home narrowly last week. Draws wider but she is making good progress. MY BETTOR HALF (13) and CYCLONE JENNI (7) are both first four players with even luck from tricky draws.
